description: This file contains internal declarations and function prototypes related to cryptographic random number generation in BoringSSL, including entropy collection, system RNG access, and RDRAND hardware support.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Collects entropy from CPU or OS for seeding DRBG, indicating source.

methods.name: RAND_bytes_with_additional_data
methods.description: Samples random bytes after mixing in user-provided additional data.

methods.name: RAND_load_entropy
methods.description: Feeds entropy into the RNG system, optionally from CPU.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand
methods.description: Fills buffer with entropy from the operating system.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand_for_seed
methods.description: Fills buffer with entropy suitable for seeding DRBG.

methods.name: CRYPTO_init_sysrand
methods.description: Initializes resources for system RNG, inline if not defined.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand_if_available
methods.description: Attempts to fill buffer with system entropy, non-blocking if available.

methods.name: rand_fork_unsafe_buffering_enabled
methods.description: Checks if fork-unsafe buffering is enabled.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_init
methods.description: Initializes CTR_DRBG state with entropy and optional personalization.
